turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We don’t currently ship internationally outside of the United States and select regions in Canada.

Here’s how our shipping works:

Where we ship:

Contiguous United States for all products
Select products to Alaska and Hawaii
Select items to limited regions in Canada (seasonally, typically March through August)

Customs, duties, and taxes:

United States: There are no customs or import duties, as all orders ship from our nurseries in Oregon.
Canada: Prices are shown in CAD and already include all duties and taxes in the listed price. You would not pay additional customs or duty fees on delivery.

If you let me know which country you’re in, I can clarify whether any options are available for you and what to expect at checkout.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Transit time itself is usually pretty quick: once your order leaves our Oregon nursery, delivery is typically 1–5 business days within the contiguous United States.

A couple of helpful details:

At checkout, you’ll choose an estimated arrival date from our delivery calendar. Those options already factor in both our processing time and the carrier’s transit time to your address.
If you check out with an express method like Shop Pay or PayPal and skip the calendar, our system will assign an estimated arrival date automatically, which you’ll see in your order confirmation email.
You’ll receive a tracking email as soon as your order ships so you can follow its progress.

If you tell me your state or province and what you’re ordering (roses, bulbs, perennials), I can give a bit more specific timing for your situation.
